title: tpysui Command Taxonomy
description: Meta-schema for pysui_commands.json and user_commands.json. Every command file validated against this schema before use.

Source.description: Where the UI pre-populates candidate values for an arg or named-compound field. 'none' means plain text input only.

Validation.description: Scalar value validation hint used by the UI widget and service layer. Semantics: 'none'=plain text; 'sui_address'=0x-prefixed 64-char hex; 'type_tag'=fully-qualified Move type expression with optional nested generics (e.g. 0x2::coin::Coin<0x2::sui::SUI>); 'move_identifier'=<pkg>::<module>::<name> where pkg is a sui_address and module/name are Move identifier strings (letter-first, alphanumeric+underscore); 'unsigned_int'=non-negative integer; 'bool'=boolean rendered as Toggle; 'base64'=base64-encoded blob; 'base58'=base58-encoded value (includes Sui digests).

ScalarKind.description: A single primitive value. Widget rendered depends on 'validation': bool -> Toggle; others -> Input (with source-driven picker if source != none).

NamedField.description: One field within a named compound. Carries its own source hint so CollectorModal can render the appropriate widget per column.

name.description: The kwarg key name as pysui expects it.

optional.description: True if this field may be absent from the produced dict.

NamedCompoundKind.description: A dict with a fixed, named set of fields (e.g. {address: str, version: int}). Rendered as a multi-column row in CollectorModal.

KeyedCompoundKind.description: A homogeneous dict where every entry shares the same key and value types (e.g. dict[str, int]). Keys are always scalar.

Kind.description: The type+shape of a value. One of: scalar, named compound, keyed compound.

Arg.description: One argument to a command. 'multiple: true' means the user builds a list; CollectorModal is used. 'min_items' is required when multiple is true.

name.description: The kwarg name passed to the SuiCommand constructor.

optional.description: True if the arg may be omitted from the kwargs entirely.

default.description: [] = no default; [x] = pre-populate with x; [x,y,...] = static Select with Other fallback.

multiple.description: True if the arg accepts a list; CollectorModal accumulates entries.

min_items.description: Minimum list length before submission is allowed. Required when multiple is true. Consistent with optional: min_items>=1 implies optional=false.

Command.description: One command entry. Source (pysui vs user) is determined by which file the entry is loaded from, not by a field in the entry itself.

name.description: The class name within source_module to instantiate (e.g. 'GetObject').

source_module.description: Fully-qualified Python module path containing the command class (e.g. 'pysui.sui.sui_common.sui_commands').

group.description: Display group label in the sidebar / command picker (e.g. 'Coin / Balance').

mode.description: 'read' for query-only commands; 'write' for mutation commands.

pageable.description: True if the result may include a next_page_token. Enables the Next button in the UI.

custom_ui.description: True if this command uses a bespoke modal instead of ArgsModal. Defaults to false.

description.description: Short human-readable description shown in the ArgsModal title bar.

args.description: Ordered list of arguments. next_page_token is never listed here — it is managed internally by the service layer.
